payload.instructions: Navigate to https://teknikforce.com/affiliate, complete application form for Teknikforce, and record status as done.

url_chain: teknikforce.com/affiliate -> failed to load ('Frame with ID 0 is showing error page')

WebSearch found teknikforce.com/affiliates (plural) - 'Affiliate Opportunities... Here's a list of our awesome software products for Internet marketers that you can sell as an affiliate. We offer 50% commissions on all our products.' - this is NOT a single affiliate program but a directory table of ~40 separate independent SaaS products (AdPlify, Adstorm, AI Collective, Blogi, Callsi, Cinemation, Cloudfunnels, Cohortia, Complyfi, Converti, Coursefunnels, Diggy Miner, Engagi, Freezur, Helpira, Imimic, Lead2List, Livecaster 4, Logii, MailEngine, Mighty Memes, Outrich, People Bots, Pinflux, Pixci, Postifluence, Qroq, Selli, Sendster, ShopFunnels, Tarantula SEO Crawler, Thumble, Tube Rank Jeet, Tubetarget, Vidatia, Vidicom, Vidko, VidScribe, Voisi, Webinarloop, Webira, Writix), each with its own separate 'Sales Site' and 'Affiliate Site' URL

Inspected one representative product's affiliate page as a sample: https://getadplify.in/affiliate ('Adplify Affiliate Invitation') - confirms these run on the JVZoo marketplace platform ('Top 1% JvZoo Affiliates & Vendors', 'Top 5-10 Affiliates', vendor is 'Cyril M. Gupta' / Teknikforce). The page itself only offers an email opt-in ('Sign up to Affiliate List') plus a 'Get Your Affiliate Link' CTA - actually generating a usable affiliate link requires having (or creating) a JVZoo marketplace account, which is a password-protected account (email+password), separate from Teknikforce's own site.

Conclusion: 'teknikforce' as a single backlog item does not correspond to one application - it is an umbrella of ~40 independent product-level JVZoo affiliate programs, each requiring the same JVZoo account (or a per-vendor request) to get a tracking link. Routed to princess both because (a) JVZoo requires a password-protected account and (b) a human needs to decide which of the ~40 individual Teknikforce products, if any, are worth listing/promoting on coshuma.com before applying per-product.
result.note_on_fit: Unlike every other backlog entry, 'teknikforce' is a portfolio/umbrella brand, not a single product with one affiliate program. The vendor (Cyril M. Gupta, via Teknikforce) sells ~40 separate SaaS tools on the JVZoo marketplace, each with its own dedicated 'Affiliate Site' signup page (pattern: https://get<productname>.in/affiliate or similar, e.g. getadplify.in/affiliate, getadstorm.in/affiliate). A single COSHUMA affiliate-application record cannot meaningfully cover all 40. Recommend the human either (a) pick specific Teknikforce products already listed/relevant on coshuma.com and apply per-product via JVZoo, or (b) skip this umbrella entry entirely and treat any individual Teknikforce product as its own future backlog item if/when it's added to the directory.
